items.title: Show HN: Remove LinkedIn reaction-promoted posts using uBlock
items.contentSnippet:
If you're like me, and 99% of your LinkedIn feed is just "likes this" or "celebrates this" repost spam from LinkedIn to make it "appear" like their feed is an actual feed, add this to your uBlock filters:
linkedin.com##div:has(> h2):has-text(/likes this/i)
linkedin.com##div:has(> h2):has-text(/celebrates this/i)
linkedin.com##div:has(> h2):has-text(/supports this/i)
linkedin.com##div:has(> h2):has-text(/loves this/i)
linkedin.com##div:has(> h2):has-text(/finds this insightful/i)
linkedin.com##di
